factions.name: The Archivists of Ash
factions.role: Keepers of dead history and Legacy hoards.

passive.name: Curated Ruin
passive.text: Salvage costs 2 Influence instead of 3 (once per turn).

active.name: Redact Name
active.text: Once per game, during an Urn vote: cancel up to 2 ballots cast against you.

factions.name: The Scrubber Guild
factions.role: Engineers controlling the failing oxygen recyclers.

passive.name: Air Tax
passive.text: Gain +1 Influence from the supply whenever a rival Contributes.

active.name: Vent the Sector
active.text: During Whisper: spend 4 Influence. A rival must pay you 2 Influence or be Embargoed this turn.

passive.name: Binding Oath
passive.text: Once per Whisper: make one accepted deal binding. Whoever breaks it loses 2 LP.

active.name: Whispered Paranoia
active.text: After dials are set: peek at one rival's dial, then you may change yours.
active.designNote: Cost not specified in the GDD: default 2 Influence, once per turn.

passive.name: Brutal Efficiency
passive.text: Sabotage costs 1 Influence when the target is the LP leader (ties count).

active.name: Martial Law
active.text: Reactive: spend 3 Influence to ignore a Crisis penalty that would hit you personally (not EH changes).

factions.name: The Blight Wardens
factions.role: Quarantine officers weaponizing the bunker's pathogens.

passive.name: Asymptomatic Carrier
passive.text: Your first Blight Cube never drains you. When you Sabotage, you may move 1 of your Blight Cubes onto the target.

active.name: Inoculate
active.text: During Whisper: spend 2 LP to remove every Blight Cube from any player (usually sold at extortionate prices).

factions.name: The Black Urn Directorate
factions.role: Bureaucratic executioners of the Council's decrees.

passive.name: Casting Vote
passive.text: Your Urn ballot counts as 2 votes. You break every Urn tie however you choose, which avoids the EH tie penalty unless you choose chaos.

active.name: Subpoena
active.text: Once per turn, during Whisper: force one player to reveal their exact LP to everyone.
active.designNote: Frequency not specified in the GDD: default once per turn, free.
